report:
Reviewed all three implementation entries and the sole associated TODO test for deterministic_emission. The requirements are independently stable definition identities and semantic ordering at each emitter, including forward references, with no comparator sorting, renumbering, or repair. Review scope is emitter registration/ordering/serialization; it does not reassess authored expression-checking behavior.

sage_emit::emit_module constructs a fresh Emitter, pre-registers the entire supported module tree, then emits. Registration starts the counter at zero, follows expanded-item vector order recursively, registers enum variants in their represented order, source impl functions and associated type identities, and rejects duplicate registration. normalize_def consults this completed map, with variant constructors mapped to their parent variant. emit_mod traverses the same expanded order and source impl-function selection, so forward references do not allocate IDs on first use. Captured expansion and enum helpers preserve ordered input traversal rather than hash-map enumeration. External references use structured crate/path segments and explicit semantic kind conversion, not pointer addresses.

sage_oracle::emit_crate rejects compiler errors, constructs a fresh Emitter, pre-registers from HIR module item order recursively, then emits in that same order. Registration and emission share the source impl-function filter excluding derive-generated functions; enum variants and associated type identities are registered before translation. normalize_def looks up the preassigned local ID, and external paths are assembled from definition parents then reversed into root-to-leaf order with explicit namespace-kind conversion. Stable numbering means deterministic numbering for each specified source ordering, not an assertion that deliberately reordered source must retain identical ordinal IDs. Fixed-projection exclusions are separate from this determinism claim.

sage_oracle_harness::assert_crates_eq serializes each immutable Crate independently with the same pretty JSON renderer and compares exact text. The helper returns success only for identical text. JSON parsing and structural diff happen only after inequality, and even structurally equal but textually different output returns Err. There is no sorting, paired normalization or renumbering in this path. Fixture-discovery sorting elsewhere orders test execution, not emitted semantic items. Captured rust-ref definitions store Module.items and path segments in Vecs and derive serialization, retaining producer order and identity fields.

The only associated test, service_spec::todo::crates_sage_oracle_harness_crate_deterministic_emission, contains no executable assertions. It explicitly defers association/review of repeated fixtures, forward references, deliberate item reorderings and namespace-kind identity/order sensitivity. This is honest verification debt: source inspection of preregistration and exact comparison is not repeated-run or cross-process evidence. The prerequisite is the described independent emitter fixture matrix with explicit expected identities/semantic order, plus adversarial namespace-kind changes that exact comparison rejects. Nearby tests under other anchors are not counted as this anchor's complete coverage. No source edits or tests executed; commands were review start/read and source inspection before recording. No additional requested edits, and deferred verification remains visible.
